numbers: 谵妄数日；十七年（承前）；「两个月内下葬」（Bertie）

facts.fact: Roland 不见好：烧成谵妄、对墙里的鬼喃喃、唤母亲、认不出你
facts.anchor: His fevers turned into a delirium.
facts.verbatim: His fevers turned into a delirium.

facts.fact: Ida/Clara 抱你哭；Bertie 悄悄打听后事——你几乎扇她耳光、被拉住：友谊第一道裂
facts.anchor: the first crack in your friendship
facts.verbatim: the first crack in your friendship

facts.fact: 烧退：某晨他醒来抚发问你为什么哭；你想吞下他的一部分（发/指甲/皮肤）留住他
facts.anchor: You wanted to consume some part of him
facts.verbatim: You wanted to consume some part of him

facts.fact: 可爱的一天：帮他沐浴、发缠指、恐惧低语进脉搏；那夜感激深睡
午夜后他醒来：走过窗、走廊（经 Ida/Clara 的备用卧室）、下楼、进入寒冷的山夜
facts.anchor: past the spare bedroom where Ida and Clara slept
facts.verbatim: past the spare bedroom where Ida and Clara slept

facts.fact: 你余生都在想：他想念迷宫？在毒园找什么？还是口渴找山泉
facts.anchor: You’d wonder for the rest of your life.
facts.verbatim: You’d wonder for the rest of your life.

facts.fact: 早晨空床；穿他的丝袍、在为他建的房子里唤他；遣人查校园/花园/秋千/小湖；自己走进迷宫
facts.anchor: the house you’d built for him
facts.verbatim: the house you’d built for him

facts.fact: Roland 蜷在乌头与三叶草间、已冻僵；查呼吸、摸不跳的心；他的眼找不到你的
facts.anchor: Roland lay curled in a patch of hemlock and clover.
facts.verbatim: Roland lay curled in a patch of hemlock and clover.

facts.fact: 尖叫引来帮手：你整把吞乌头被拖开；Ida 逼喝醋催吐；Clara 坐尸旁哭；Bertie 下令移走并烧园
facts.anchor: Bertie ordered him removed and the garden burned
facts.verbatim: Bertie ordered him removed and the garden burned

facts.fact: 「如移骨，你内里某样根本的东西移位了」——你再不会是原来的你
facts.anchor: You would never be the same.
facts.verbatim: You would never be the same.
